name: com.nabagame.reward
description: Reusable reward features for NabaGame projects: Daily Reward, Online Reward (timed grid with x2/x5 ad speed-up), Lucky Spin. Game-agnostic and data-free: the host fills each manager's row list with its own rewards, every player action comes back as an event the host handles (granting included), and audio/ads plug in through a small hooks contract. See Documentation~ for architecture and integration guides.

samples.description: Runnable demo of Daily Reward and Lucky Spin: two scenes with row lists filled on the scene-placed managers, panel + template prefabs, home buttons with red-dot badges, a SampleRewardGranter subscribing to the grant events and mapping Row.Key onto its own economy, and a reward-received ceremony popup driven by the granter's grant event.
